# noust_backup_schedule (Resource)

The scheduled backups of an application, run by a systemd timer on the server, with their retention and the remote destinations each backup is copied to. An application has at most one schedule.

A schedule is a root timer and its retention decides which backups are thrown away, so creating or changing one needs the permission `root_equivalent` and sudo mode (and a second person's approval on a server that asks for it); removing one needs `backups.manage` and sudo mode. Removing it stops future backups; the backups already made stay.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Back the application up every night at half past three, keep the last 14 and nothing older than two
# months, and copy each one to a destination created in the console.
resource "noust_backup_schedule" "api" {
  app             = noust_application.api.domain
  schedule        = "*-*-* 03:30:00"
  retention_count = 14
  retention_days  = 60

  destinations = [
    {
      name           = "offsite-sftp"
      retention_days = 90
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) The domain of the application to back up. Changing it replaces the schedule.

### Optional

- `destinations` (Attributes List) Remote destinations (created in the console's backup destinations) each backup is copied to, with the retention kept there. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))
- `include_databases` (Boolean) Dump the application's databases as well. Default `true`.
- `retention_count` (Number) How many of the backups this schedule made to keep. Default `7`. `0` leaves the server's `backup.max_per_app` in charge, over every backup of the application.
- `retention_days` (Number) The age in days after which a backup this schedule made is thrown away. Default `30`. `0` is no age limit.
- `retention_gb` (Number) The most the backups this schedule made may weigh together, in gigabytes. The newest always stays. No limit when omitted.
- `schedule` (String) `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly` or a systemd `OnCalendar` expression such as `*-*-* 03:30:00`. Default `daily`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The application's domain.
- `on_calendar` (String) The calendar expression the timer runs on.
- `timer` (String) The name of the systemd timer.

<a id="nestedatt--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Required:

- `name` (String) The destination's name.

Optional:

- `retention_count` (Number) How many backups to keep there.
- `retention_days` (Number) How many days to keep a backup there.
- `retention_gb` (Number) The most the backups of this application may weigh there, in gigabytes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The application's domain.
terraform import noust_backup_schedule.api api.example.com
```
